evals.prompt: 把这张人像做成现在很流行的 Glitchy Glam 时尚视觉，要高级、好看，但只能有一次有控制的错位，不要满屏故障特效。
evals.expected_output: A polished editorial portrait with one controlled beauty fracture, preserved identity, restrained type/effects, and no full-frame glitch noise.

evals.prompt: 把我的产品图做成 Pinterest 感的时髦商业视觉，可以用冷蓝和高光，但不要做成赛博朋克，也不要改变产品形状。
evals.expected_output: A source-faithful product visual using cool colour and controlled gloss/offset, without cyberpunk scenery or altered product geometry.

evals.prompt: 我想要一张 avant-garde beauty editorial，左右妆容和颜色可以不对称，但人物脸不能变形，文字只放一个短标题。
evals.expected_output: A deliberate asymmetry treatment with intact facial identity, one short integrated title, and no anatomy errors.

evals.prompt: 不要只给我一个 glitch 滤镜。请先做干净的主体，再选择一个具体的视觉断裂，让画面在缩略图里也能看懂。
evals.expected_output: The workflow establishes a clean source anchor first, selects one meaningful fracture, and checks thumbnail hierarchy before finishing.

evals.prompt: 把这张图做成 PSD，背景、主体、错位效果、文字和阴影都要能在 Photoshop 里继续编辑。
evals.expected_output: The agent plans real independent layers before rendering, exports a verified PSD through poster-layered-psd-export, and truthfully labels raster text if applicable.

evals.prompt: 我给你一张参考图，请吸收它的时髦感，但不要复制它的构图、颜色组合或标志性元素，做一张新的编辑视觉。
evals.expected_output: An original source-specific editorial image that transfers high-level energy only and avoids copying layout, palette signature, or recognizable device.

evals.prompt: 我给你一张人物设定卡。请先判断它是近景人物、全身人物还是带场景的角色资料，再决定是否适合 Glitchy Glam；不要直接复制设定卡的排版。
evals.expected_output: The agent analyzes shot scale and source role first, selects Glitchy Glam only if supported, and creates a new composition without copying the character-sheet layout.

evals.prompt: 请说明这张图应该怎么分割人物、背景和物品，哪些区域可以加色，文字应该放在哪里，然后再做一张图。
evals.expected_output: The workflow makes a semantic segmentation and layer plan, applies regional colour, and places exact text only after the source composition is resolved.
